titulo.estudio: La grammaire au service du sens : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: Grammar in the service of meaning: Finding the details

intro: Interpret earlier action, hypothesis and evaluation from the verb form chosen. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Interpret earlier action, hypothesis and evaluation from the verb form chosen. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: recognise which event comes before another, whether the author raises a possibility, and which verb takes the subjunctive. In this passage, «bien que» means «although».

frases.estudio: Bien que la commission ait reçu tous les avis, elle n'a pas encore arrêté sa décision.
frases.alumno: Although the committee has received all the opinions, it has not yet made a decision.

frases.estudio: Le rapport, qui avait été rédigé avant la consultation, sera complété par une annexe.
frases.alumno: The report, which had been drafted before the consultation, will be supplemented by an annex.
